paragraphs.text: You blaze away at this new species.

Each of you may get off one shot per rifle at normal range. If the 
shooter succeeds with a DEX roll, they may fire again at point-
blank range (granting a bonus die). If together you inflict 10 or 
more points of damage, go to 399. If not, go to 367.
